_comment: Provider-punning spinner verbs for REMOTE cloud-API sessions. Consumed as Claude Code settings key spinnerVerbs {mode:'append'|'replace', verbs:[...]} — verified present in CLI 2.1.270. Generated by local-model dispatch 2026-09-15, then CURATED: the raw output was ~1/3 unusable (non-punning words like 'Driving'/'Kidding'/'Demotivating'/'Mistrusting', and hyphenated forms violating the one-word rule). Only single-word forms that audibly carry the provider name are kept.
_contract: One word, present participle, capitalized, ASCII, no spaces/hyphens, must echo the provider name. The 'general' list is the neutral fallback used when the provider cannot be identified; it must never be empty, or the spinner silently keeps Claude Code's defaults.
